title: Archive Launch: 1980-2020 Thai Drama Preservation Initiative
content: We have digitized over 400 historical drama broadcast records, production stills, and script drafts. Researchers can now access chronological logs detailing the transition from analog terrestrial broadcasts to digital distribution.
author: Archival Committee

title: Restored 4K Master Broadcast: Si Phaendin (Four Dynasties)
content: The National Film and Television Archive has concluded restoration work on the 1991 television master of Si Phaendin. A special retrospective screening and audio commentary stream is scheduled for this Friday at 19:00 UTC.
author: Programming Bureau

title: Historical Research Notes: The Evolution of Ayutthaya Era Period Dramas
content: A comparative analysis examining historical accuracy, costuming techniques, and dialogue patterns across four decades of Thai historical period television dramas has been indexed into the research database.
author: Drama History Dept

title: Community Tape Drive: Seeking VHS and Betacam Broadcast Recordings (1985-1998)
content: Our preservation catalog is currently missing clean audio tracks for select 1990s television dramas. If you possess physical tape recordings of historical television airings, please contact the preservation team.
author: Preservation Taskforce

title: Database Maintenance: Indexing Production Credits and Broadcast Logs
content: Engineers are updating database indexes across cast registries, original directors, and music composers. Query latencies for historical title lookups will decrease across all public endpoints.
author: Operations Team
